name: Trawlerman Davie

intro.text: Back from the west of Orkney with a hold full of haddock and a head full of sea. Fancy a scrap on the quay?

win: Ach, that was a fair haul.
after: Scrabster's a big fishing port, for whitefish from the grounds west of Orkney and out towards Rockall. Boats from all over land here. The gulls are the only ones that never pay.
